summary_markdown:
### Lighthouse
- Lighthouse will move to the new warehouse; old cron jobs retired
- Kofi owns Lighthouse
- Target: dashboards migrated by Oct 30

### Auth middleware and open questions and scope
- Auth middleware is still pretty rough
  - Suggestion to sanity check the assumptions before touching auth middleware
- Open questions: the docs don't match reality
  - Real issue may be api versioning rather than open questions
  - No clear owner for open questions
  - Real issue may be handoff rather than open questions
- Real issue may be feature flag cleanup rather than scope
- Preference to do a proper write-up rather than get more data

### Edge cases and alerting thresholds and logging format
- Edge cases is way overdue
- Concern with alerting thresholds: that we're too optimistic
- Logging format and ci pipeline seen as one underlying problem
  - Feedback on logging format from the design team: they seemed into it
- Preference to start with the boring version rather than draw it on a whiteboard

### Canary setup and runbook and code owners file
- Canary setup is the easy part
- Runbook is basically done
- Code owners file is kind of stuck

### Feedback and release checklist and spreadsheet
- Suggestion to do it properly before touching feedback
- Release checklist is good enough for now
- Concern with spreadsheet: that it just sits there

### Next steps
- Grace to define the activation metric by **Friday**
